jobs.title: Product Director - Core Platform
jobs.description:
Description

At Red Rover, we believe there is no greater calling than to serve those who are shaping the minds of our future generations. K-12 education has become increasingly complex. Schools are expected to do more with less while also handling uncharted social situations - and they deserve better. Join us as we build creative, intuitive software solutions for school administration that help put the best educators in every school, every day.

We keep our product engineering team small and incredibly talent-rich. We believe this helps us respond quickly to customer needs without a lot of red tape. Inspired by 37signals’ Shape Up methodology, our team consists of engineers, designers and customer experts that shape and pitch real-world problems together, then bet on the best solutions using science, creativity, and (a whole lot of) customer empathy.

Who You Are

You're someone who shares our passion for helping school administrators serve their educators, students, and community. You sit comfortably at the intersection of product, design, and engineering. You’ve built your career on turning raw feedback into product strategy that deliver real business and user outcomes, while being fluent enough in technical architecture to earn the trust of engineers.

You’ve got passion for curating a robust platform of integrated experiences and guiding each contributing team to build something bigger than any one product line. You thrive in ambiguity, lead with curiosity, and know how to balance long-term platform investment against near-term delivery pressure. You're as comfortable facilitating an architectural discussion as you are writing acceptance criteria or sketching a user flow.

What You'll Do

Own and evolve the Core Platform roadmap, balancing system resilience and performance investments with enabling new capabilities and expanding our mobile experience for product teams and customers.
Own the developer platform of services and libraries consumed by other teams, incl. design system, navigation, auth, and shared workflows.
Gather feedback and requests from internal stakeholders, customers, and prospects on challenges and opportunities that foster a unified, intuitive platform experience regardless of which product(s) a customer purchases.
Shape ideas in partnership with cross-product and engineering leaders into well-formed pitches that balance user needs, business goals, and technical feasibility. Define clear problem boundaries, success criteria, and possible approaches before work begins.
Pitch shaped work and lead the betting process with cross-functional platform stakeholders, aligning on tradeoffs and outcomes to ensure we’re solving the right problems at the right time.
Design and iterate on user flows, visual sketches/wireframes, and AI prototypes to communicate ideas and inform implementation.
Coordinate closely and creatively with product teams to keep making progress without allowing the Core Platform team to become a bottleneck.
Communicate platform decisions and rationale clearly and effectively across the company, ensuring alignment and transparency.
Champion a strong product culture centered around empathy, experimentation, and measurable outcomes.

Requirements

You have 6+ years of experience in web/mobile product management roles (ideally leading solutions where the primary consumers are other dev teams).
You demonstrate strong product thinking and an uncanny ability to simplify complex jobs to-be-done into intuitive user experiences.
You understand and can clearly communicate complex technical and architectural concepts to mixed audiences.
You excel at framing the story of each user journey and bring clarity where there’s uncertainty.
You lead with empathy, are energized by collaboration, and know when to zoom in on details and when to stay focused on the big picture.
You value people over process, working code over extensive artifacts, collaboration over itemized requirements, and responsiveness to change.
You avoid letting “perfect” get in the way of good, incremental progress towards your goal. You view ambiguity as an opportunity to learn from others and try something new.
You hold yourself to exemplary personal and professional ethical standards and work well in a team-oriented, collaborative environment.
You have experience in K-12, HR tech, B2B SaaS, or workflow-heavy platforms (a plus).

jobs.title: Senior Manager of RF Design Engineering
jobs.description:
Mini-Circuits designs, manufactures and distributes integrated circuits, modules, and sub-systems for high-performance radio frequency (RF) and microwave applications. With design, sales and manufacturing locations in over 30 countries, Mini-Circuits’ products are used in a range of wired and wireless communications applications. Our products are also used in detection, measurement and imaging applications, including military communication, guidance and electronic countermeasure systems, commercial, scientific, military land, sea and aircraft; automotive systems, medical systems, and industrial test equipment.

Mini-Circuits’ sells its products to over 20,000 customers globally through our direct sales force,
applications engineering staff, sales representatives, as well as through our extensive website.

Position Summary:

The Sr. Manager of Design Engineering – LTCC is responsible for leading all design aspects of the LTCC Design Team’s development activities. The Sr. Manager of Design Engineering will focus on executing the LTCC product development engineering function as a cohesive unit, the conceptualizing and day-to-day management of simultaneous projects, delivering manufacturable designs to agreed specifications within time and budget constraints, and the fostering of innovative solutions to customer needs.

This position has reporting responsibility to the Director of Engineering - LTCC.

Salary Range:
$175,000 - $200,000 per year

Job Function:

Manage the design of RF & Microwave circuits, components and sub-assemblies, focused on Filters, Power Splitters, Couplers, and Baluns, for high-performance and multi-function devices. Modify existing designs to improve performance, quality, manufacturability, production yields, etc.
Accountable for adherence to device perturbation and sensitivity analysis process to ensure highest possible production yields, meeting deadlines and resolving performance issues along the way.
Direct and manage the performance of the group’s circuit, components and sub-assemblies’ analysis and simulation efforts employing commercially available EDA Software including PSpice, Method of Moments (MoM), Finite Element Method (FEM) engines (i.e. Genesys, ADS, HFSS, CST), and other CAD tools.
Develop novel and accurate multi-physics simulation models, DOEs, and technology characterization efforts to forecast production-level and field performance
Responsible for the management of a library of FEM and MoM simulation models including connectors, PCBs, LTCCs, Cal Standards, Wire bonds and lumped components, among others.
Create and implement an optimum design flow and strategy geared to lower turnaround times, increase component’s performance and rate of 1st spin success while ensuring manufacturability, improving yields, and lowering costs
Responsible for the team’s design approach, topology selection criteria, technological choice, design time budgeting, and overall technical approach to any requirement meeting deadlines and resolving performance issues along the way.
Research & utilize latest techniques & approaches, analyze user input, and identify and establish performance standards. Develop processes and procedures to verify and validate designs through simulations, tests and reliability studies.
Serve as technical support to Production, Quality, Reliability, Supply Chain, Sales, Marketing, Engineering Test & Manufacturing Process Engineering departments on new and existing designs.
Prepare application notes, technical articles, test plans & catalog specs for publication.
Interface with Operations, Quality Assurance, Reliability and Strategic Sourcing groups to guide device and material qualification efforts and manufacturability reviews. Responsible for ensuring products not only meet performance requirements but are reliable and manufacturable as well.
Evaluate components, materials & suppliers.
Create a map of competing technologies and elaborate a SWOT analysis of our current LTCC offerings within that context
Lead and actively participate in design review meetings.
Provide technical support directly to customers.
Promote and contribute the Patent/IP Program.
Solve technical, operational and design group issues.
Provide engineering execution excellence of design and development projects.
Ensure deadlines are met and team members are held accountable.
Provide guidance and execution on product roadmap.
Work with the Director of Engineering - LTCC to define yearly budget for CapEx, personnel and development expenses for the LTCC Design Team; track and execute to the defined budget.

Supervisory Responsibilities:

Manage the LTCC Design team to support multiple projects simultaneously with competing priorities.
Supervise, train, direct and mentor Design and Applications Engineers, sales, and marketing members
Define objectives and track results for team members as well as proposing figures of merit and KPIs intended to capture the design team’s performance
Organize and lead the work of the Design Team by delegating assignments, provide guidance to achieve projects objectives in accordance with established timelines, budgets and policies.
Responsible for determining the skills, workload expectations, and performance rewards for all new and current group members.
Keep projects focused and manageable.
Manage rigorous documentation during the design effort, including design documentation, qualification test and validation reports, supporting analysis in accordance with the company’s quality standards.
Provide technical vision and direction to ensure the design team is aligned with the strategy of the LTCC Business Unit and company.

The duties, responsibilities and expectations described above are not a comprehensive list and additional tasks may be assigned to the member, within the scope of the position.

Qualifications:

BSEE with minimum of 13 years’ related design and management experience OR;

MSEE with minimum of 10 years’ related design and management experience – preferred.
Must have experience managing a multi-functional engineering development group and have demonstrated ability to manage a team of engineers to create & support the activities during the life cycle of products, from conception through production within stated time frames.
Minimum of 10 years’ relevant experience in microwave circuit design of passive components such as Filters, Power Splitters, Couplers, and Transformers operating to the mmWave range.
Minimum of 8 years’ relevant experience in the design of RF Filters.
Familiarity with circuit simulation and both 2.5D and 3D EM simulation techniques.
Real-world strong lab analysis and debug experience required to verify simulated performance.
Professional and positive approach, self-motivated, strong in building relationships, team player, dynamic, creative with the ability to work on own initiative.
Demonstrated strong oral and written communication skills.
Past experience working for an ISO company that practices LEAN manufacturing.
Proven experience in developing products under a Phase Gated Process (PGP).
Must be a US Citizen or US Permanent Resident (Green Card Holder) due to ITAR compliance.

Physical Demands:

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to talk and hear. The employee frequently is required to stand, walk, sit and use hands to operate a computer keyboard. The employee is occasionally required to reach with hands and arms. The employee must occasionally lift and/or move up to 10 pounds. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, and ability to adjust focus. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

Additional Requirements/Skills:

“Out of the box” thinking is key; contributes to the products roadmap and is willing to take innovative product risk while balancing the roadmap for on-time deliverables.

Strong relationship management, strategy development, project management, problem solving and change management skills.
Must have the ability to build relationships and work successfully with members outside of those within their direct reporting structure.
Manage diverse, simultaneous projects of varying complexities.
Comply, understand, and support corporate safety initiatives to ensure a safe work environment.
Ability and willingness to abide by Company’s Code of Conduct.
Occasional travel, some overnight, as required (up to 30%).

Head of Engineering

Fully Remote - US or Canada

Base $250k - $325k + Equity

FutureTech Recruitment is partnered with a consumer mobile app that has been the #1 product in its category for over 12 years - 85M+ downloads, millions of daily active users, and backed by a publicly traded $2B+ company. Startup speed with enterprise stability. The CEO is rebuilding the engineering function from the ground up and giving this hire full permission to do it their way.

They’re hiring a Head of Engineering to own the entire engineering function - team composition, architecture, AI-native workflows, and delivery accountability. jobs.title: Director of Engineering
jobs.description:
About Allia Technology

Allia Health Group builds technology across multiple healthcare brands — Brello / HelloWellness, Southend Pharmacy, and Allia Care. Our Technology organisation runs on a deliberate operating model: an upstream Strategy & Execution engine that turns brand strategy into a ranked, capacity-feasible roadmap reflecting only committed value, and a downstream AI-Native Technology Operating System (AIN-TOS) that delivers it through a 4-quarter roadmap, two-week Linear cycles, capacity-mapped pods, and a shared operating system of standards (design, engineering, QA, agent OS, security, observability).

We are scaling the leadership of this organisation. As the CTO concentrates on Artificial Intelligence and Robotics, we are creating a Director of Engineering to own the build-and-run heart of the function: Software, Cloud & Security, and Internal IT.

The Role

The Director of Engineering is the single accountable owner for how Allia builds, ships, secures and runs its platforms and internal systems. You will lead three functions — Software, Cloud & Security, and Internal IT — covering roughly 19+ engineers and specialists across frontend, backend, fullstack, QA automation, cloud/DevOps, security (SecOps and GRC), and internal IT operations.

You own delivery and reliability end to end, operating the engineering functions against AIN-TOS so the CTO is free to focus on the frontier. You translate the committed roadmap into shipped, high-quality, secure software on a predictable rhythm — protecting capacity honesty, enforcing the shared OS, and keeping pods autonomous but coherent.

This is a hands-on leadership role for someone who has run multi-team engineering organisations, cares about operating discipline as much as technical excellence, and can hold reliability, security and delivery accountable simultaneously.

What You Will Own

Engineering delivery. Accountable for shipping the committed roadmap across Brello, Patient Platform, Realtime Data Hub, Zito Care and supporting platforms. Run fixed two-week Linear cycles as the single delivery rhythm; map team capacity against cycle priorities; close cycles with demos and retros that feed the learning loop.

Platform reliability and cloud. Own cloud architecture, infrastructure and DevOps (AWS / GCP). Accountable for uptime, performance, incident response and the operational health of everything in production.

Security posture. Own security strategy and execution across SecOps and GRC, including the path to and maintenance of SOC2. Ensure security validation is built into delivery controls before release, not bolted on after.

Internal IT. Own internal systems, identity and access management, user management, web operations and procurement — the systems the whole company depends on.

The shared OS. Maintain and evolve engineering standards, QA standards, deployment frameworks and observability as shared infrastructure that pods consume rather than rebuild. Local autonomy, global coherence.

Talent and structure. Lead, coach and grow three function heads and their teams. Close open positions (Software, Cloud & Security and Internal IT currently carry open seats), uplevel capability, and build a bench.

Translate, commit, report. In our decision-rights model, technology leadership translates strategy into demand, runs assessment and capacity mapping, and reports committed versus realised value. You carry that responsibility for the engineering functions and represent them in the executive operating cadence.

How You Will Work

You will operate inside an established, opinionated operating model. Success means running it well, not replacing it:

Capacity is honest. Capacity is real, not aspirational. You and your leads protect it. The roadmap reflects only what can actually be delivered.
Pods own delivery. Pods are autonomous, integrated, and free of a central queue. You set standards and remove blockers; you do not become the bottleneck.
Commitment is two-sided. Engineering commits to deliver; quality and security controls are non-negotiable gates before release.
Override is visible. Recommendations and overrides are separate and both logged. Decisions are transparent.
Learning compounds. Every release feeds the shared OS. Incidents, retros and adoption data become standards, prompts and infrastructure.

You will run the bi-weekly cycle cadence (planning, cycle-close demos, retros) and the weekly rhythm (intake triage, cycle health, blockers cleared), and contribute to the monthly portfolio review and quarterly roadmap rebuild.

What We Are Looking For
Must Have

8+ years in software engineering with 4+ years leading engineering organisations, including managing managers / function leads.
Proven track record shipping production software on a predictable delivery cadence across multiple teams.
Strong command of modern cloud infrastructure (AWS and/or GCP), DevOps practices, and production reliability at scale.
Real ownership of security in an engineering context — comfortable being accountable for security posture and compliance (SOC2 or equivalent).
Experience operating within a structured delivery system (cycles/sprints, capacity planning, defined standards) and the discipline to protect it.
A builder of people: hiring, coaching, levelling and retaining strong engineers.
Clear, executive-level communicator who can translate between strategy and delivery and report committed vs. realised value credibly.

Strongly Preferred

Experience across the full stack of functions you'll own — software delivery, cloud/infra, security, and internal IT — or a demonstrated ability to lead functions outside your original specialism.
Background in regulated or healthcare environments, or other settings where security, compliance and reliability are first-class.
Familiarity with AI-native engineering practices and agent-based tooling (we run an "agent OS" as part of our shared OS).
Experience with Linear (or comparable) as a system of record for delivery.

How You Lead

You treat operating discipline as a feature, not overhead.
You make capacity and commitments honest, even when the answer is uncomfortable.
You give teams autonomy and hold them to shared standards.
You are calm and decisive in incidents, and you make every incident a source of compounding improvement.

Why This Role Matters

This is one of the most consequential leadership hires in Allia Technology. You will take direct ownership of the engineering, platform, security and IT backbone of a multi-brand healthcare technology group — and in doing so, you free our most senior technologist to drive the AI and Robotics work that will define our advantage. You inherit a working operating model, a committed roadmap, and strong function leads. Your job is to make the build-and-run engine excellent, reliable and secure, and to lead it with the autonomy of a true owner.

Description

At Red Rover, we believe there is no greater calling than to serve those who are shaping the minds of our future generations. K-12 education has become increasingly complex. Schools are expected to do more with less while also handling uncharted social situations - and they deserve better. Join us as we build creative, intuitive software solutions for school administration that help put the best educators in every school, every day.

We keep our product engineering team small and incredibly talent-rich. We believe this helps us respond quickly to customer needs without a lot of red tape. Inspired by 37signals’ Shape Up methodology, our team consists of engineers, designers and customer experts that shape and pitch real-world problems together, then bet on the best solutions using science, creativity, and (a whole lot of) customer empathy.

Who You Are

You're someone who shares our passion for helping school administrators serve their educators, students, and community. You sit comfortably at the intersection of product, design, and engineering. You’ve built your career on turning raw feedback into product strategy that deliver real business and user outcomes, while being fluent enough in technical architecture to earn the trust of engineers.

You’ve got passion for curating a robust platform of integrated experiences and guiding each contributing team to build something bigger than any one product line. You thrive in ambiguity, lead with curiosity, and know how to balance long-term platform investment against near-term delivery pressure. You're as comfortable facilitating an architectural discussion as you are writing acceptance criteria or sketching a user flow.

What You'll Do

Own and evolve the Core Platform roadmap, balancing system resilience and performance investments with enabling new capabilities and expanding our mobile experience for product teams and customers.
Own the developer platform of services and libraries consumed by other teams, incl. design system, navigation, auth, and shared workflows.
Gather feedback and requests from internal stakeholders, customers, and prospects on challenges and opportunities that foster a unified, intuitive platform experience regardless of which product(s) a customer purchases.
Shape ideas in partnership with cross-product and engineering leaders into well-formed pitches that balance user needs, business goals, and technical feasibility. Define clear problem boundaries, success criteria, and possible approaches before work begins.
Pitch shaped work and lead the betting process with cross-functional platform stakeholders, aligning on tradeoffs and outcomes to ensure we’re solving the right problems at the right time.
Design and iterate on user flows, visual sketches/wireframes, and AI prototypes to communicate ideas and inform implementation.
Coordinate closely and creatively with product teams to keep making progress without allowing the Core Platform team to become a bottleneck.
Communicate platform decisions and rationale clearly and effectively across the company, ensuring alignment and transparency.
Champion a strong product culture centered around empathy, experimentation, and measurable outcomes.

Requirements

You have 6+ years of experience in web/mobile product management roles (ideally leading solutions where the primary consumers are other dev teams).
You demonstrate strong product thinking and an uncanny ability to simplify complex jobs to-be-done into intuitive user experiences.
You understand and can clearly communicate complex technical and architectural concepts to mixed audiences.
You excel at framing the story of each user journey and bring clarity where there’s uncertainty.
You lead with empathy, are energized by collaboration, and know when to zoom in on details and when to stay focused on the big picture.
You value people over process, working code over extensive artifacts, collaboration over itemized requirements, and responsiveness to change.
You avoid letting “perfect” get in the way of good, incremental progress towards your goal. You view ambiguity as an opportunity to learn from others and try something new.
You hold yourself to exemplary personal and professional ethical standards and work well in a team-oriented, collaborative environment.
You have experience in K-12, HR tech, B2B SaaS, or workflow-heavy platforms (a plus).

new_jobs.title: Senior Manager of RF Design Engineering
new_jobs.description:
Mini-Circuits designs, manufactures and distributes integrated circuits, modules, and sub-systems for high-performance radio frequency (RF) and microwave applications. With design, sales and manufacturing locations in over 30 countries, Mini-Circuits’ products are used in a range of wired and wireless communications applications. Our products are also used in detection, measurement and imaging applications, including military communication, guidance and electronic countermeasure systems, commercial, scientific, military land, sea and aircraft; automotive systems, medical systems, and industrial test equipment.

Mini-Circuits’ sells its products to over 20,000 customers globally through our direct sales force,
applications engineering staff, sales representatives, as well as through our extensive website.

Position Summary:

The Sr. Manager of Design Engineering – LTCC is responsible for leading all design aspects of the LTCC Design Team’s development activities. The Sr. Manager of Design Engineering will focus on executing the LTCC product development engineering function as a cohesive unit, the conceptualizing and day-to-day management of simultaneous projects, delivering manufacturable designs to agreed specifications within time and budget constraints, and the fostering of innovative solutions to customer needs.

This position has reporting responsibility to the Director of Engineering - LTCC.

Salary Range:
$175,000 - $200,000 per year

Job Function:

Manage the design of RF & Microwave circuits, components and sub-assemblies, focused on Filters, Power Splitters, Couplers, and Baluns, for high-performance and multi-function devices. Modify existing designs to improve performance, quality, manufacturability, production yields, etc.
Accountable for adherence to device perturbation and sensitivity analysis process to ensure highest possible production yields, meeting deadlines and resolving performance issues along the way.
Direct and manage the performance of the group’s circuit, components and sub-assemblies’ analysis and simulation efforts employing commercially available EDA Software including PSpice, Method of Moments (MoM), Finite Element Method (FEM) engines (i.e. Genesys, ADS, HFSS, CST), and other CAD tools.

new_jobs.title: Director of Engineering
new_jobs.description:
About Allia Technology

Allia Health Group builds technology across multiple healthcare brands — Brello / HelloWellness, Southend Pharmacy, and Allia Care. Our Technology organisation runs on a deliberate operating model: an upstream Strategy & Execution engine that turns brand strategy into a ranked, capacity-feasible roadmap reflecting only committed value, and a downstream AI-Native Technology Operating System (AIN-TOS) that delivers it through a 4-quarter roadmap, two-week Linear cycles, capacity-mapped pods, and a shared operating system of standards (design, engineering, QA, agent OS, security, observability).

We are scaling the leadership of this organisation. As the CTO concentrates on Artificial Intelligence and Robotics, we are creating a Director of Engineering to own the build-and-run heart of the function: Software, Cloud & Security, and Internal IT.

The Role

The Director of Engineering is the single accountable owner for how Allia builds, ships, secures and runs its platforms and internal systems. You will lead three functions — Software, Cloud & Security, and Internal IT — covering roughly 19+ engineers and specialists across frontend, backend, fullstack, QA automation, cloud/DevOps, security (SecOps and GRC), and internal IT operations.

You own delivery and reliability end to end, operating the engineering functions against AIN-TOS so the CTO is free to focus on the frontier. You translate the committed roadmap into shipped, high-quality, secure software on a predictable rhythm — protecting capacity honesty, enforcing the shared OS, and keeping pods autonomous but coherent.

This is a hands-on leadership role for someone who has run multi-team engineering organisations, cares about operating discipline as much as technical excellence, and can hold reliability, security and delivery accountable simultaneously.

What You Will Own

Engineering delivery. Accountable for shipping the committed roadmap across Brello, Patient Platform, Realtime Data Hub, Zito Care and supporting platforms. Run fixed two-week Linear cycles as the single delivery rhythm; map team capacity against cycle priorities; close cycles with demos and retros that feed the learning loop.

Platform reliability and cloud. Own cloud architecture, infrastructure and DevOps (AWS / GCP). Accountable for uptime, performance, incident response and the operational health of everything in production.

Security posture. Own security strategy and execution across SecOps and GRC, including the path to and maintenance of SOC2. Ensure security validation is built into delivery controls before release, not bolted on after.

Internal IT. Own internal systems, identity and access management, user management, web operations and procurement — the systems the whole company depends on.

The shared OS. Maintain and evolve engineering standards, QA standards, deployment frameworks and observability as shared infrastructure that pods consume rather than rebuild. Local autonomy, global coherence.

Talent and structure. Lead, coach and grow three function heads and their teams. Close open positions (Software, Cloud & Security and Internal IT currently carry open seats), uplevel capability, and build a bench.

Translate, commit, report. In our decision-rights model, technology leadership translates strategy into demand, runs assessment and capacity mapping, and reports committed versus realised value. You carry that responsibility for the engineering functions and represent them in the executive operating cadence.

How You Will Work

You will operate inside an established, opinionated operating model. Success means running it well, not replacing it:

Capacity is honest. Capacity is real, not aspirational. You and your leads protect it. The roadmap reflects only what can actually be delivered.
Pods own delivery. Pods are autonomous, integrated, and free of a central queue. You set standards and remove blockers; you do not become the bottleneck.
Commitment is two-sided. Engineering commits to deliver; quality and security controls are non-negotiable gates before release.
Override is visible. Recommendations and overrides are separate and both logged. Decisions are transparent.
Learning compounds. Every release feeds the shared OS. Incidents, retros and adoption data become standards, prompts and infrastructure.

You will run the bi-weekly cycle cadence (planning, cycle-close demos, retros) and the weekly rhythm (intake triage, cycle health, blockers cleared), and contribute to the monthly portfolio review and quarterly roadmap rebuild.

What We Are Looking For
Must Have

8+ years in software engineering with 4+ years leading engineering organisations, including managing managers / function leads.
Proven track record shipping production software on a predictable delivery cadence across multiple teams.
Strong command of modern cloud infrastructure (AWS and/or GCP), DevOps practices, and production reliability at scale.
Real ownership of security in an engineering context — comfortable being accountable for security posture and compliance (SOC2 or equivalent).
Experience operating within a structured delivery system (cycles/sprints, capacity planning, defined standards) and the discipline to protect it.
A builder of people: hiring, coaching, levelling and retaining strong engineers.
Clear, executive-level communicator who can translate between strategy and delivery and report committed vs. realised value credibly.

Strongly Preferred

Experience across the full stack of functions you'll own — software delivery, cloud/infra, security, and internal IT — or a demonstrated ability to lead functions outside your original specialism.
Background in regulated or healthcare environments, or other settings where security, compliance and reliability are first-class.
Familiarity with AI-native engineering practices and agent-based tooling (we run an "agent OS" as part of our shared OS).
Experience with Linear (or comparable) as a system of record for delivery.

How You Lead

You treat operating discipline as a feature, not overhead.
You make capacity and commitments honest, even when the answer is uncomfortable.
You give teams autonomy and hold them to shared standards.
You are calm and decisive in incidents, and you make every incident a source of compounding improvement.

Why This Role Matters

This is one of the most consequential leadership hires in Allia Technology. You will take direct ownership of the engineering, platform, security and IT backbone of a multi-brand healthcare technology group — and in doing so, you free our most senior technologist to drive the AI and Robotics work that will define our advantage. You inherit a working operating model, a committed roadmap, and strong function leads. Your job is to make the build-and-run engine excellent, reliable and secure, and to lead it with the autonomy of a true owner.

Harmattan AI is a next-generation defense prime building autonomous and scalable defense systems. Following the close of a $200M Series B, valuing the company at $1.4 billion, we are expanding our teams and capabilities to deliver mission-critical systems to allied forces.

Our work is guided by clear values: building technologies with real-world impact, pursuing excellence in everything we do, setting ambitious goals, and taking on the hardest technical challenges. We operate in a demanding environment where rigor, ownership, and execution are expected.

Location:
Rabat, Morocco — on site. Contract:
Permanent, full time

About The Role

As the Director of Engineering for UAS Development at Harmattan AI, you will build and lead a new engineering organisation from the ground up in Rabat, Morocco.

This is a founding role, not a succession: the site opens this year, the leadership layer does not exist yet, and you will help to hire it. You will lead six engineering modules to around 50 collaborators. This is a sovereign capability, engineered locally from first principles with no design package transferred in from another site.

You will own the full technical chain, take the system through qualification and into series production against a fixed contractual calendar, and build the local supplier base and engineering ecosystem that sustains it. You will report directly to the VP Engineering with regular exposure to our CTOs, our General Manager Morocco, and the customer.

Responsibilities

Organisation Building: Stand up the engineering group from an office that is still opening - reach full staffing at pace without lowering the bar.
Programme Delivery: Hold a fixed milestone calendar where dates are contractual, and set an operating cadence built around the programme rather than a generic quarterly rhythm.
Technical Ownership: Own the full technical chain across airframe, propulsion, avionics, launcher and ground segment, through to flight test and trials on local soil.
People Management & Mentorship: Manage managers while staying close to the engineering — run design and programme reviews across five disciplines in the same week, and calibrate a leadership layer you built yourself.
Local Ecosystem: Develop the local supplier base and entity operations, which in the first year sit with this role rather than with a support function.
Stakeholder & Customer Interface: Work directly with the General Manager, Chief Engineer, programme management, group CTOs and the customer, owning the evidence and milestone relationship end to end.

Candidate Requirements

Educational Background: An MSc in Mechanical, Aerospace, Electrical or a strongly related engineering field. A track record of building organisations will outweigh the degree.
Proven Leadership: An engineer who moved into management and then into managing managers, with at least four direct reports who were themselves leads.
Experience: 10+ years, with at least 4 in engineering management. You have stood up or materially scaled an engineering site — including hiring it locally, at pace.
Programme Track Record: You have taken a hardware system through qualification and into series production against fixed contractual milestones, ideally under a defence customer. Background in UAV, autonomous systems or advanced robotics.
Technical Engagement: While this is a leadership role, you remain credible across every discipline in the group without claiming depth in any, and you take written positions on the cross-module questions no one else will close.
Commitment: 100% dedication to Harmattan AI's mission of building autonomous defence systems, on site in Rabat with regular travel to Paris and Lausanne.

We look forward to hearing how you can help shape the future of autonomous defense systems at Harmattan AI.

new_jobs.description:
Careers that change lives start here. Medtronic is a global leader in healthcare technology with a Mission to alleviate pain, restore health, and extend life. Our 95,000 employees work across more than 150 countries to put patients first — developing innovative medical technologies that improve the lives of 72+ million patients each year. Your unique talents will help shape the future of healthcare while building a career grounded in purpose, growth, and impact.

A Day in the Life

Position Description/Responsibilities

At Medtronic, we bring bold ideas forward with speed and decisiveness to put patients first in everything we do. In-person exchanges are invaluable to our work. We're working onsite 4 days a week as part of our commitment to fostering a culture of professional growth and cross-functional collaboration as we work together to engineer the extraordinary. The person in this role will work a Hybrid Model from the Medtronic facility located in Costa Rica

As a Senior Software Engineering Manager and Product Owner of the Medtronic Azure Cloud Platform, you will lead a team of Dev/Ops and cloud software engineers. You will continuously improve our software engineering practices while investing in the growth of each member of the team. Our team is responsible for the global standards and configuration of Medtronic Azure cloud with over 600 accounts in the US, Europe, Asia Pacific, and Greater China. We architect and maintain deployment, account management, networking, Ingress/Egress, account and service provisioning, global configuration guard rails, operational and security observability, and 24/7 operations. Our team partners with the business to understand their use cases and requirements. We also partner with Microsoft and our stakeholders in security, privacy, legal, and operations to curate and design how Medtronic consumes Azure services. Our team define standards, implement policy-based controls, and create service catalog code standards, reusable code artifacts, and CI/CD pipelines and integrations that enable consistent self-service for our application teams to consume. We maintain configuration standards that align with HIPAA, ISO, GDPR, and other industry and regulatory standards and guidance from Azure as to how services must be deployed for compliance. Our team includes a FinOps practice that monitors spend and trends to continuously refine how to meet application requirements in an efficient manner. We write and maintain code to address changes across many accounts achieving specific outcomes such as cost reduction, technical debt reduction, security posture improvement, configuration drift management, response to evolving operational issues, and improvements to inventory management.

Cloud Platform Services is a team that is passionate about making a difference and we value being action oriented, collaborative, accountable, team oriented, and focused on patient centered quality.

We believe that when people from different cultures, genders, and points of view come together, innovation is the result —and everyone wins. Medtronic walks the walk, creating an inclusive culture where you can thrive. Our unwavering commitment to inclusion, diversity, and equity (ID&E) means zero barriers to opportunity within Medtronic and a culture where all employees belong, are respected, and feel valued for who they are and the life experiences they contribute. We know equity starts beyond our workplace, and we must play a role in addressing systemic inequities in our communications to achieve long-term sustainable impact. Anchored in our Mission, we continue to drive ID&E forward both to enhance the well-being of Medtronic employees and to accelerate innovation that brings our lifesaving technologies to more people in more places around the world.

Bring your talents to an industry leader in medical technology and healthcare solutions – we’re a market leader and growing every day. You can be proud to be a part of technologies that are rooted in our long history of mission-driven innovation. You will be empowered to shape your own career. We encourage and support your growth with the training, mentorship, and guidance you need to own your future success. Together, we can transform healthcare. Join us for a career in IT that changes lives. Medtronic is committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive culture. Check out the accomplishments of our Women in IT group! http://bit.ly/MedtronicWomeninIT

CAREERS THAT CHANGE LIVES

Lead, coach, and mentor a team of software engineers who build and maintain the enterprise Azure cloud for Medtronic. Lead a team that manage Financial Operations for Cloud – (FinOps)
Continually improve our software delivery by maturing our software engineering practices (CI/CD, automated testing, cloud-native architectures).
Collaborate cross functionally with engineering, security, service delivery, and privacy teams, among other teams, to deliver best in class systems.
Influence and collaborate with internal and external stakeholders, peers, and leadership to remove barriers for the team
Oversee activities of development and design requirements for software systems, applications and software quality assurance for enhancements and new products, including cloud-based platforms, to meet the current and future software needs
Manage activities to ensure programs are appropriately resourced and ensure continuous improvement in technical capability, process, and compliance
Manage scope, cost, and schedule within a cross-functional Dev/Ops team
Create and manage expectations with team members, stakeholders, cross functional teams, and leadership
Select, develop, coach, and evaluate personnel to ensure the efficient operation of the function
